# 第1题

**题型**: 选择题

**难度**: ★★★☆☆

**分值**: 1.5分

---

## 题目内容

Recently，I took a trip home by train．I got a seat opposite a middle-aged man with sharp eyes，who kept____1____a young woman in a window seat with a little boy on her lap．The woman's eye fell on the man's face，and she immediately looked down and____2____her scarf．As the night wore on，people began to close their eyes，but the seats were so uncomfortable that only a very heavy sleeper could manage to get any____3____．The woman looked over at the man．He was still staring at her．She looked back at him with fire in her eyes．I was beginning to get____4____，too．The train moved on．The little boy was ____5____ awake on his mother's lap，but the woman dropped off to sleep．A moment later，he began to____6____the half-open window—one leg went over it．The man jumped up and ____7____the child just before he fell out．The____8____ woke up the woman．She seemed to be in____9____，and then reality dawned（显现）．“Your child has been looking for an opportunity to climb out of the window，”the man said as he gave the child back to her. ．“So I have been watching the whole time．”The woman was _____10_____，and so was I．

## 选项

A. A. guiding

B. B. bothering

C. C. watching

D. D. monitoring

## 小题

### 1

1. A. guiding B. bothering C. watching D. monitoring

**答案**: C

### 2

2. A. adjusted B. changed C. packed D. waved

**答案**: A

### 3

3. A. air B. joy C. space D. rest

**答案**: D

### 4

4. A. nervous B. embarrassed C. angry D. disappointed

**答案**: C

### 5

5. A. almost B. still C. hardly D. even

**答案**: B

### 6

6. A. drag B. climb C. knock D. push

**答案**: B

### 7

7. A. grabbed B. rocked C. touched D. picked

**答案**: A

### 8

8. A. alarm B. quarrel C. risk D. noise

**答案**: D

### 9

9. A. sorrow B. relief C. panic D. pain

**答案**: C

### 10

10. A. astonished B. confused C. concerned D. inspired

**答案**: A

---

## 参考答案

C
analysis: 本题考查冠词用法。第一空泛指“一个有趣的故事”，用不定冠词an；第二空“the story”特指前面提到的那个故事，用定冠词the。选项A正确。B项第一空a错误，因为interesting以元音音素开头；C项第二空a错误；D项第一空a错误。
